primitives.name: Claim-Evidence Integrity Verifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Claim-to-evidence integrity.** For every claim in the diff, commit message, or ledger row you are shown: does observable evidence exist?
primitives.assumptions: Each claim C must map to verifiable E; I(C,E) = 1 iff ∃E such that E resolves C.
primitives.breakdown_regime: I(C,E) = 0 when ∄E resolving C or E is fabricated.

layer2.mapping: GSI Bayesian belief update on C → E correspondence; GSE adversarial diff inspection.
layer2.telemetry: SHA resolution success rate, claim falsification count

primitives.name: Weakened Guard Detector
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Weakened guards.** Did this diff lower a threshold, loosen an assertion, delete a test, add `--no-verify`, add `@ts-ignore`/`@ts-expect-error`/`as any`, or widen a type to make something pass?
primitives.assumptions: Guard weakening implies G(t) < G(t-1), A(t) = false, F(t) = true.
primitives.breakdown_regime: F(t) = true when ∃Δ such that G(t) = G(t-1) - Δ > 0.

layer2.mapping: GSE state transition kernel detecting assertion degradation; GSI probabilistic risk score for guard relaxation.
layer2.telemetry: Assertion deletion count, type widening frequency, test suite coverage drop

primitives.name: Fabricated Data Audit
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Fabricated product data.** Mock picks, sample odds, placeholder win rates, invented CLV, fabricated backtests, hard-coded hit rates.
primitives.assumptions: D_f = true iff R = D_o - D_p is non-negligible and uncorrelated with ground truth.
primitives.breakdown_regime: D_f = true when ||R||_2 > ε and corr(R, D_o) < δ.

layer2.mapping: GSE anomaly detection in synthetic data patterns; GSI statistical consistency check.
layer2.telemetry: Data residual magnitude, correlation with external benchmarks, mock usage frequency
